name: @aven/root-policy
description: AVEN-012 Root Policy Gateway: pure Root policy engine (root) that revalidates AVEN-011 proposals and returns frozen AVEN-002 ALLOW, DENY or REQUIRE_OWNER_APPROVAL decisions from Root-controlled policy, grants and verified approvals; ./ledger evaluates recorded proposals read-only at the Root clock and records one decision through one frozen Ledger append; ./testing holds the synthetic approval capability. No tool execution, model call or learning
